services.desc: Building confident, disciplined kids through Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Ages 4 and up. First class is always free. Our youngest grapplers begin in the Champs Class, designed for children ages 4 to 6. Through structured movement, age-appropriate games, and positive repetition, they learn to listen, coordinate their bodies, and follow instructions - building the foundation every young athlete needs. Here in Richmond, TX, we see kids arrive timid and leave beaming. The Lions Class serves ages 7 to 12 with real technique, competition awareness, self-defense application, and the kind of discipline that carries into every classroom in Fort Bend County. Both programs are subdivided by size and skill
